title: Non-idempotent side-effect compensation
invariants: pending reservation is never automatically re-executed after process loss
reconciliation requires exact request identity plus independent evidence references
reconciliation never invokes the original tool handler
effect_committed becomes a terminal succeeded receipt without metering a new tool call
effect_absent becomes a terminal failed receipt and does not reuse the original idempotency key
effect_compensated becomes a terminal failed receipt carrying durable compensation evidence
identical reconciliation replay is stable and conflicting evidence fails closed
saga recovery never double-compensates an effect already proved absent or compensated
claim_limit: Implementation evidence only; independent exact-head evidence is required before verified_closed.
